themes.label: Climate
themes.definition: Atmospheric conditions and their trends: temperature, precipitation, snow, growing season, water deficit and climate projections.

themes.label: Water
themes.definition: Surface and ground water resources, irrigation and drainage infrastructure, water balance, stress and access to water services.

themes.label: Land & agriculture
themes.definition: Land cover and land use, soils, vegetation condition, cropland and pasture productivity, livestock and agricultural carbon.

themes.label: Forests & carbon
themes.definition: Forest extent, structure, condition and change, together with carbon sequestration and reforestation potential.

themes.label: Biodiversity
themes.definition: Species, habitats, landscapes, ecoregions, protected areas and conservation value.

themes.label: Hazards & terrain
themes.definition: Terrain and geomorphology, and the natural hazards shaped by them: seismicity, floods, mudflows, drought and their recorded impacts.

themes.label: Infrastructure
themes.definition: Built environment: settlements, their change over time, and transport networks.

datasets.label: CHIRPS v3 precipitation
datasets.description: Computed pentadally; the daily product is a disaggregation of it and agrees to 0.00% over a month. Version 3 sits under UCSB-CHC, not the UCSB-CHG path version 2 uses, and differs from it by about nine percent here.

distributions.label: CHIRPS v3 precipitation Earth Engine collection

datasets.label: CHIRTS daily temperature

datasets.label: HydroLAKES v1.0 (global source)
datasets.description: Global reference hydrography, plus the two national subsets extracted from it. Both extractions select every basin with a positive-area intersection with Uzbekistan and keep whole polygons, so basin statistics computed from them describe the basin, not the part inside the border.

datasets.label: HydroRIVERS v1.0 (Asia source)
datasets.description: Global reference hydrography, plus the two national subsets extracted from it. Both extractions select every basin with a positive-area intersection with Uzbekistan and keep whole polygons, so basin statistics computed from them describe the basin, not the part inside the border.

datasets.label: Land-cover training samples
datasets.description: 198,615 labelled polygons across 11 classes, assembled from the per-class cadastre exports. The training asset for a supervised land-cover model; class balance is extreme, so it must be sampled rather than used as-is.

datasets.label: Meteorological station network
datasets.description: 86 stations. The .dbf carries no encoding declaration and must be read as cp1251 or the names arrive as mojibake. Station numbers are six-digit operator codes, not the five-digit WMO indices used by the climate workbooks, so the two cannot be joined until a crosswalk is supplied.
